The '''''Blue Wave''''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Transport/Legends|cargo hauler]] that served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
The ''Blue Wave'' transported medical supplies and other non-combatant equipment that were meant to be delivered to [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cells throughout the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]]. The [[Transport/Legends|cargo hauler]] was eventually sabotaged by [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] and exploded on its approach to [[Daltarra]]. The storm commandos traced the incoming shipment to specific locations and individuals in [[Quenin]], which led to the discovery of a Rebel listening outpost on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="RES" /> The Rebel listening outpost was subsequently eliminated by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="SW:R">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref>
